# University of Wollongong

> A world-class Australian university with 350+ courses across 11 global campuses offering excellence in teaching, learning, and research.

The University of Wollongong (UOW) is a leading research institution based in Australia with an extensive global presence spanning Asia-Pacific regions including India, UAE, Hong Kong, China, Malaysia, and Singapore. The university serves domestic and international students through multiple pathways including ATAR entry, TAFE progression, and direct admission.

## Study Programs & Admissions

- [Study at the University of Wollongong](https://www.uow.edu.au/study): Study programs portal with 350+ courses across 11 worldwide campuses
- [Apply to UOW](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/apply): Application portal for domestic and international students via UAC and direct admission
- [Entry Pathways](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/admission-info/pathways): Entry pathways including ATAR, TAFE, and alternative admission routes
- [High School Students](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/high-school): High school student pathways including ATAR entry and AIME mentoring
- [Non-School Leaver Students](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/non-school-leaver): Pathways for mature age, TAFE, and non-school leaver students
- [Postgraduate Students](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/postgraduates): Postgraduate coursework and research degrees with fee reductions
- [International Students](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/international): International student admissions, scholarships, and pathway programs

## Student Support & Services

- [Current Students Portal](https://www.uow.edu.au/student): Student portal with course management, enrollment, and academic administration
- [Library Services](https://www.uow.edu.au/library): UOW Library collections, database search, and academic support services
- [Scholarships & Financial Aid](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/scholarships): Scholarships and financial aid for domestic and international students
- [Accommodation](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/accommodation): On-campus accommodation options and application via StarRez portal
- [Study Abroad & Exchange](https://www.uow.edu.au/study/study-abroad-exchange): Study abroad and exchange programs through AEN and Global Student Mobility

## Global Presence & Campuses

- [Campuses & Teaching Locations](https://www.uow.edu.au/about/locations): UOW campus locations including Wollongong, Sydney, and Innovation Campus
- [Global Presence](https://www.uow.edu.au/about/global-presence): UOW's international campuses in UAE, Hong Kong, China, Malaysia, and Singapore
- [UOW India](https://www.uow.edu.au/india): UOW India campus in GIFT City, Gujarat offering masters and fintech programs

## About & Engagement

- [University of Wollongong Homepage](https://www.uow.edu.au): UOW homepage: world-class university with excellence in teaching, learning, and research
- [Give to UOW](https://www.uow.edu.au/giving): Donation and fundraising portal for scholarships and research funding
